messages:
alex_cs: quick draft for impacted tenants — need a fast review before we send. short and clear: status, mitigations, timeline, credits, invite to office hours. tagging priority list after review. :wave:

maria_eng: thanks. root cause was a throttled indexing worker pool after a config rollout at 03:12 UTC. we rolled back at 03:40 and backfill started. ingestion rate is ~85% of normal now. ETA for caught-up: ~6–8 hours depending on queue.

jamie_pm: can we call out renewal-sensitive tenants in the outbound? ask CS to offer a 1:1 Q&A and a proactive credit for billing windows impacted. tone: apologetic + pragmatic.

alex_cs: yes — plan to include a short paragraph for high-risk customers to trigger SEP (sales enablement) handoff. draft below — please edit: 

alex_cs: ```Hi <Customer>,
We’re sorry — between 03:10–03:40 UTC an internal indexing change caused delayed batch processing for new uploads and trial onboarding imports. We’ve rolled back the change and processing is underway; most accounts are processing now and we expect full catch‑up within 6–8 hours.

What we’re doing: we reverted the rollout, backfilled the queue, and increased temporary worker capacity.
What you can expect: no data loss; feature availability is intact, search/embeddings will be complete once backfill finishes.
Next steps: we’re scheduling office hours (link) for affected customers and offering a one-time service credit if your onboarding window was affected.
If you’d like prioritized help, reply and we’ll arrange a dedicated session.
Thanks for bearing with us — Alex (Customer Success)```

maria_eng: small edit — change "increased temporary worker capacity" to "scaled up backfill workers by 3x" and add note that we patched a config mismatch in the queue sharding logic. also add incident id INC-2026-17855.

alex_cs: updated. pushed in: ```...scaled up backfill workers by 3x and patched a queue-shard config mismatch (INC-2026-17855)....```

ops_bot: incident INC-2026-17855 status: RESOLVED (config rollback + backfill triggered). reference: https://redwood.status/incidents/INC-2026-17855 :white_check_mark:

jamie_pm: for renewal talks — add a line offering a 30‑minute migration/implementation review for customers in renewal window. volunteer to join any escalations.

sophia_se: I can run 2 office hours today (1500 and 1900 UTC). please add a short RSVP form and attach troubleshooting checklist. I'll capture feedback and common obstacles.

alex_cs: perfect. final checklist before send: 1) legal okay on credit language (maria can confirm) 2) L10 priority list appended 3) RSVP link + calendar invites 4) support tag for SEP handoffs. aiming to send at 10:00 UTC.

maria_eng: legal ok on one-time credit phrasing as long as we cap language "up to X credits" — legal will DM exact wording in 10m.

jamie_pm: I'll add the renewal flag to the priority list and ping AE owners.

alex_cs: thanks all — i'll queue the send and post the final outbound here before blasting. will also attach a short feedback form to capture whether the delay affected renewal decisions. :thumbsup:
